128045.overview:
Wild Man Jump by Vtech
1981 Rare Tabletop game, in which you play a Donkey Kong type game. This game features a large multi-coloured display using backlit LCD technology.

477157.overview:
Now you can play the magical Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs game! You must help guide Snow White safely through the forest to the home of the lovable Seven Dwarfs. At the cottage, Snow White dances with Dopey, Sneezy and Grumpy -- which proves to be a challenging task! But all is not safe for Snow White -- the Wicked Witch had found her and given her a poison apple! Help rescue Snow White so she can meet her true Prince and live happily ever after!

Help Snow White through the forest to the Dwarfs' cottage! Watch out for dangers and obstacles along the way!

Snow White and the Dwarfs dance— but not without a little trouble! Help Snow White avoid Dopey's coat tails, Sneezy's sneezes and kiss Grumpy's head to score points!

Snow White has taken a bite from the Wicked Witch's poison apple! Help Grumpy chase the Witch and avoid lightening bolts and boulders!

479215.overview:
Tiger Electronics The Jungle Book Handheld LCD Game 1992 A vintage, single-player electronic handheld game featuring characters Mowgli, Baloo, and monkeys from Disney's The Jungle Book.

Controls & Features: Equipped with a central LCD screen, directional red/green arrow controls on the left, action/call buttons on the right, and sound/start settings at the bottom.

Power: Typically operated using standard AA batteries for portable retro gaming.
